mapper.sql: F.QSTNR_SN, F.QSTNR_TYPE_CD, F.EVL_SE_CD, F.QSTNR_NM, F.REG_DT, F.RGTR_NM, F.MDFCN_DT, F.MDFR_NM, F.DEL_DT, F.DLTR_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_QSTNR_MST ( QSTNR_TYPE_CD, EVL_SE_CD, QSTNR_NM, RGTR_NM, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{qstnrTypeCd}, #{evlSeCd}, #{qstnrNm}, #{rgtr}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_QSTNR_MST SET QSTNR_NM = #{qstnrNm}, MDFR_NM = #{mdtr}, MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE QSTNR_SN = #{qstnrSn} AND QSTNR_TYPE_CD = #{qstnrTypeCd} AND DEL_DT IS NULL
UPDATE EDU_QSTNR_MST SET DEL_DT = NOW(), DLTR_NM = 'admin' WHERE QSTNR_SN = #{qstnrSn} AND QSTNR_TYPE_CD = 'SURVEY' AND DEL_DT IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT Q.QSTN_SN, Q.QSTNR_SN, Q.QSTN_NO, Q.ANS_TYPE_CD, CASE Q.ANS_TYPE_CD WHEN 'LIKERT5' THEN '리커트 5점' WHEN 'LEVEL5' THEN '상중하 5단계' WHEN 'TEXT' THEN '주관식' ELSE Q.ANS_TYPE_CD END AS ANS_TYPE_NM, Q.QSTN_CN, Q.SORT_SEQ, Q.REG_DT, Q.RGTR_NM, Q.MDFCN_DT, Q.MDFR_NM FROM EDU_QSTNR_QSTN Q WHERE Q.QSTNR_SN = #{qstnrSn} ORDER BY Q.SORT_SEQ ASC, Q.QSTN_SN ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_QSTNR_QSTN ( QSTNR_SN, QSTN_NO, ANS_TYPE_CD, QSTN_CN, SORT_SEQ, RGTR_NM, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{qstnrSn}, #{qstnNo}, #{ansTypeCd}, #{qstnCn}, #{sortSeq}, #{rgtr}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_QSTNR_QSTN SET QSTN_NO = #{qstnNo}, ANS_TYPE_CD = #{ansTypeCd}, QSTN_CN = #{qstnCn}, SORT_SEQ = #{sortSeq}, MDFR_NM = #{mdtr}, MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE QSTNR_SN = #{qstnrSn} AND QSTN_SN = #{qstnSn}
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT(A.RSVT_SN, '-', COALESCE(A.STDNT_SN, 0)) AS RESPONSE_KEY, A.REG_DT AS SUBMITTED_DT, CASE WHEN A.STDNT_SN IS NULL THEN '교사' ELSE '학생' END AS PARTICIPATION_TYPE, R.SCYR_NM AS SCHOOL_LEVEL, NULL AS GENDER, NULL AS RESIDENCE, A.QSTN_SN, Q.QSTN_NO, COALESCE(A.QSTN_CN, Q.QSTN_CN) AS QSTN_CN, A.ANS_CN FROM EDU_LRN_ANS A LEFT JOIN EDU_RSVT_MST R ON R.RSVT_SN = A.RSVT_SN LEFT JOIN EDU_QSTNR_QSTN Q ON Q.QSTN_SN = A.QSTN_SN AND Q.QSTNR_SN = A.QSTNR_SN WHERE A.QSTNR_SN = #{qstnrSn} AND A.ANS_TYPE_CD = 'SURVEY' AND A.DEL_DT IS NULL ORDER BY A.REG_DT, A.RSVT_SN, COALESCE(A.STDNT_SN, 0), Q.SORT_SEQ, A.LRN_ANS_SN
